plain.next: Next time, try checking whether an extra unit still earns more than its cost before saying growth hurts margin.

after.topFix: Open with a real, tailored profit tree instead of a list of areas: restate the objective, then split profit into revenue (price × traffic × items per visit) and costs (COGS, labor, overhead/rent), and say which branch you'd test first and why.
